title: Podcast website
when: The user wants a site for a podcast with episodes, players and show notes.
inputs: episodes with number, date, audio file, notes
prompt:
Goal: A site where new listeners understand the show and play an episode in one click.
Steps:
1. Hero with show name, one line topic, the latest episode and a play button.
2. Episode list: number, title, date, duration, short summary, link to its notes.
3. Each episode page or section: audio element with controls and preload="none", notes, links, transcript if given.
4. Hosts with photos and a sentence each.
5. Where to listen links with clear text.
Quality bar:
- Players never autoplay.
- Transcripts or summaries make episodes searchable.
- Durations shown.
Pitfalls:
- Loading every audio file on page load.
- Icon only platform links.
- No episode numbers.
Verify:
- [ ] audio has controls and preload none.
- [ ] Link text is descriptive.
- [ ] time elements for dates.
- [ ] One h1.
Output: index.html, an episodes page if needed and style.css.

examples.input: site para meu podcast de tecnologia
examples.output: hero with latest episode player, list of 10 episodes with durations, hosts, listen links
